Preserve the product geometry, materials, proportions and colors throughout. Begin with a tight macro shot of fine water droplets sliding across the titanium surface. The camera performs a slow controlled dolly backward while the amber ring wakes with one soft pulse. Concentric ripples spread across the shallow black water and faint mist drifts behind the product. No hands, people, logos, labels or text.

overall_soundscape: Close, tactile water droplets; a low clean electronic hum rising gently; one deep but restrained pulse when the amber ring turns on; subtle room-sized reflections.

Hold the product and camera perfectly still for the first one second while the water ripples settle. [Shot 2] At 00:01 the camera begins a smooth clockwise orbit at medium-slow speed. Thousands of tiny silver and midnight-blue particles rise from the water, but never touch or alter the headphones. The particles organize into elegant concentric acoustic-wave ribbons around the product, visualizing spatial sound. The amber light ring responds with two measured pulses. Reflections and parallax remain physically correct. Keep exactly one pair of headphones with unchanged titanium shell, blue cushions, shape and scale. End on a clean side three-quarter hero view with the acoustic ribbons forming a wide halo behind it. No dialogue, people, text, logos, extra products or morphing.

overall_soundscape: Smooth spatial whooshes moving around the listener, tiny metallic particles chiming softly, two precise low-frequency pulses synchronized with the amber light.

non_diegetic_music: The minimal electronic score gains a restrained rhythmic pattern and wide stereo texture, still luxurious and uncluttered, no vocals.

## 段3（00:16–00:24）— 能量定格

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Continue seamlessly from the previous segment's exact final composition. Hold for one second with no camera motion as the particle halo contracts gently. [Shot 2] At 00:01 the headphones rise only a few centimeters above the volcanic pedestal, remaining rigid and physically unchanged. The camera cranes downward slightly while continuing a slow orbit, revealing expanding blue-and-amber wave patterns across the water. Finish at 00:07 with a perfectly stable centered full-product hero shot matching the original product identity: brushed titanium, midnight-blue cushions, thin amber ring, black studio, water and mist. Ease all motion to stillness for the final second. Exactly one product. No dialogue, no people, no text, no logo, no watermark, no deformation, no duplicated earcups and no floating parts.

overall_soundscape: A controlled rising tonal sweep, deep spatial bass bloom as the product lifts, gentle water movement, then a soft magnetic settling sound followed by one second of clean ambience.

non_diegetic_music: Cinematic electronic score reaches a refined peak with warm analog synth and subtle strings, then resolves into a single pure tone, no vocals.
